narrative.overview: Casa Guaico shops like the marketplaces Colombians already know. The Nariño identity lives in a deep verde-páramo shell, a cool off-white ground, an iraca-gold pill reserved for buying, and the ficha de tejido paired with the size calculator. Depth comes from tone steps, not shadows; photography is real and credited. The admin reuses the palette as a quieter framed sheet. It refuses the orange marketplace clone and the cream-and-terracotta artisan boutique.
keyCharacteristics: Verde páramo shell (header, footer, selected states) against a cool off-white ground.
Gold is only for the action that moves a shopper forward.
One family, Figtree, four weights (400/500/600/700); prices always tabular.
Pill buttons, 6px fields, 8px panels; flat at rest.
Product data is shown as facts, never as marketing copy.

rules.name: The Gold Means Buy Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the one forward action on a screen and nothing decorative. If two gold buttons compete, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Tone Step Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with ground, tile, surface and tone steps, not with borders and shadows.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Every number a shopper compares (prices, cm, hours, stock, counts) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: 400 body, 500 labels, 600 values and headings, 700 only on the banner headline and brand wordmark.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits above the page". Resting surfaces never get one.

dos: Do use familiar marketplace patterns first and let identity live in type, palette, density and the ficha de tejido.
Do reserve iraca-gold (#e3b23c) for the single forward action; shell green for structure and selection.
Do give every control a 150ms colour transition and every interactive target at least 40px.
Do show prices with the tabular, small-sign price component; show real product data (artisan, municipality, hours).

Do use only credited photography listed in frontend/public/images/manifest.json (title, creator, licence, source, alt, caption). Captions name the place or subject and credit the author; they never imply Casa Guaico shot or owns the photo. The full list lives on /creditos.
Do keep focus visible: 2px link-green outline, offset 2px; gold on shell surfaces.
Do announce state with text, not colour alone (struck sizes, "agotada" labels, alert roles, polite live regions).
Do keep motion to feedback: 150-220ms ease-out-expo for menus, sheets, dialogs, count bump, press scale, 500ms banner fade; collapse all durations under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use shadows on resting surfaces; only floating layers get them.
Don't use marketplace orange or cream-and-terracotta artisan-boutique palettes.
Don't invent ratings, reviews, testimonials, logos or sales proof; none exist.
Don't add a second display face, gradient text, glass effects or decorative motion.
Don't use glyph characters as icons; icons are Lucide SVGs with aria-hidden.
Don't convey status by colour alone.
Don't copy design-brief text into shipped source, comments or metadata.
